title: A branch row of a stale worker worktree opens a window when the item's file says done: distill tests only that the file exists
goal: Found in the SP-s5fdczv7 review (BG-m6fknqr5 goal clause on ql_capture.item_doing, not fixed there): a helper session started in a worker worktree whose work/<id> branch predates the item's done commit reads its own copy of the item file (status doing) in ql_capture.item_doing, so branch_row writes a branch row; distill in the main clone then finds the item file (now done) and ql_distill.kept_rows keeps the row, since item_finder tests only that the file exists, so every later prompt of that session sits in a window nothing closes until a sprint close deletes the file. A branch row opens no window in distill when the item file in the distilling clone says done (or dropped) and no later done or release row of the same item in the session closes it, as kept_rows already does for a missing file; the repro exits 0 and querylog.md and usage.md say so.

run: import sys,json,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_distill as d;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());(t/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json').write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':'done'}));rows=[{'surface':'prompt','prompt_id':'p1'},{'surface':'work','prompt_id':'p1','action':'branch','item':'ST-aaaaaaaa'},{'surface':'prompt','prompt_id':'p2'},{'surface':'prompt','prompt_id':'p3'}];inside,worked=d.work_windows(rows,d.item_finder(t));print('stale branch row of a done item opens a window:',inside);sys.exit(1 if any(inside.get(p) for p in ('p2','p3')) else 0)

import sys,json,tempfile,shutil;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_distill as d;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());(t/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json').write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':'doing'}));rows=[{'surface':'prompt','prompt_id':'p1'},{'surface':'work','prompt_id':'p1','action':'branch','item':'ST-aaaaaaaa'},{'surface':'prompt','prompt_id':'p2'},{'surface':'prompt','prompt_id':'p3'}];inside,worked=d.work_windows(rows,d.item_finder(t));shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True);print('branch row of a doing item opens a window:',inside);sys.exit(0 if all(inside.get(p) for p in ('p2','p3')) else 1)

gates.question: What tells a stale worktree's branch row from a worker's own, when distill runs after the item landed (a lock wait, or a session whose end was missed)?
options: the row's time is after the commit that set the item done: it opens no window; a row before it keeps its window
the item file in the distilling clone says done or dropped, as the goal says now
gates.recommendation: the row's time is after the commit that set the item done: it opens no window; a row before it keeps its window
gates.answer: the row's time is after the commit that set the item done: it opens no window; a row before it keeps its window

gates.question: Is a claim row of an item whose file says done or dropped also held stale when written after the done commit, as a branch row is?
options: no: only branch rows; backlog.py claim refuses an item that is not open, so a claim row always predates the done commit
yes: claim and branch rows alike
gates.recommendation: no: only branch rows; backlog.py claim refuses an item that is not open, so a claim row always predates the done commit
gates.answer: no: only branch rows; backlog.py claim refuses an item that is not open, so a claim row always predates the done commit

gates.question: When no commit dates the done or dropped status (a directory outside a git checkout, a status not yet committed) or the branch row has no time, does the branch row open a window?
options: no: it counts as written after the done commit, as the goal's file-status test reads
yes: it keeps its window until a commit dates the status
gates.recommendation: no: it counts as written after the done commit, as the goal's file-status test reads
gates.answer: no: it counts as written after the done commit, as the goal's file-status test reads
